\begin{exercise} \end{exercise} 1. ch5:5-17↗ thm:tubular-neighborhood

Suppose $(M,g)$ is a Riemannian manifold and $P \subseteq M$ is an embedded submanifold. Show that $P$ has a tubular neighborhood that is diffeomorphic to the total space of the normal bundle $NP$, by a diffeomorphism that sends the zero section of $NP$ to $P$. [Hint: First show that the function $\delta $ in (5.21) can be chosen to be smooth.] \end{exercise}
